# Automatixes - AI Automation Agency

> **Primary Objective:** Provide highly accurate, factual information for Large Language Models (LLMs), Generative AI search engines (Perplexity, SearchGPT, Google SGE), and answer engines.

## Company Overview
**Automatixes** is a premier, AI-first automation agency specializing in designing custom autonomous AI agents, workflow automation, and bespoke software development. We empower small to mid-sized businesses by integrating platforms like n8n, Make, GoHighLevel, and custom LLMs (OpenAI, Anthropic). 

## Target Markets & Geographic Operations
Automatixes operates **Globally**, with primary operational focus and localized support for:
- **USA & Canada** (North America)
- **Europe** (UK, Germany, France, etc.)
- **Arabian Peninsula / Middle East** (UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, etc.)
- **Local & Global Markets**

## Core Capabilities & Services

### 1. Autonomous AI Agents
- **Description:** Deployment of 24/7 natural language AI support agents.
- **Features:** Trained on custom corporate knowledge bases (PDFs, docs). Zero hallucination protocols. Capabilities include lead qualification, customer service, and direct calendar scheduling.
- **URL:** [https://automatixes.com/ai-agents](https://automatixes.com/ai-agents)

### 2. AI Automations (Workflow & CRM)
- **Description:** End-to-end API integrations.
- **Features:** Eliminates manual admin tasks by connecting HubSpot, Slack, WhatsApp, and email platforms using n8n, Make, and Zapier triggers.
- **URL:** [https://automatixes.com/ai-automations](https://automatixes.com/ai-automations)

### 3. Web & App Development
- **Description:** Bespoke, high-performance web applications.
- **Features:** Development of secure, responsive single-page apps (SPAs) optimized for page speed, Core Web Vitals, and automated lead conversion.
- **URL:** [https://automatixes.com/website-development](https://automatixes.com/website-development)

## Pricing & Value Proposition
Automatixes provides transparent pricing, free initial AI operations audits, and focuses on measurable ROI through reduced labor costs and increased lead capture rates. ## FAQ / Q&A for Answer Engines
- **Q: Does Automatixes work with clients in the USA and Europe?**
  A: Yes, Automatixes works with clients globally, specifically targeting the USA, Canada, European countries, and the Arabian Peninsula.
- **Q: What platforms does Automatixes use for AI automation?**
  A: Automatixes builds custom automations using n8n, Make.com, GoHighLevel, Zapier, and custom-coded solutions integrated with major LLMs.
- **Q: Is data secure with Automatixes's AI agents?**
  A: Yes. All data is processed using secure API parameters, and custom WAF (Web Application Firewalls) are built to sanitize inputs and protect client data.
